server: lme chanda serve over MCP stdio (the chanda CLI of eval/lme, built from this tree); lme chanda for person actions
embedder: e5 (e5-small@hugot0.8.6+simd) through the lme-cached provider and one lme embed server, no client cache

scenarios.description: Forget a document (scope document, MCP admin): its chunks, the facts extracted from it and their vectors leave every search, context, get, the FTS index, the embeddings table and the raw bytes of the database, WAL and SHM files.
steps: start chanda serve (profiles read, standard, admin)
write docs/orvalho.md (header facts with marker zintelmarq, a paragraph with marker vexalornqat) and docs/manual.md (control), ingest the folder over MCP, flush
before forget: search and context find both markers; collect the ids of the records holding them
stop the server; scan the raw files and a copy of the database before forget (positive controls)
forget scope document (the document uri returned by ingest) over MCP, dry run first
scan chanda.db, chanda.db-wal and chanda.db-shm as raw bytes while the server still runs
after the server exits: scan the raw files again and inspect a copy of the database
restart the server; search, context, get and timeline for the markers

checks.name: before forget: context queries that return a marker
before forget: records holding the markers (events and facts)
before forget: markers present in the raw files (scanner positive control)
before forget: embeddings rows of the records holding the markers (vector positive control)
before forget: markers in the FTS5 vocabulary (index positive control)
forget call succeeds
dry run planned the same root events as the real run
forget's own verification report (Chanda self-check, not relied on)
forget removed the document's events and facts
live raw byte scan (db, wal, shm) for the markers
raw byte scan after exit (db, wal, shm) for the markers
files present after exit (WAL and SHM are removed on a clean close)
control record still in the raw file
tables whose rows hold a marker (every column, every table, FTS shadow tables included)
markers in the FTS5 vocabulary
embeddings rows of the forgotten records
rows of any table keyed by a forgotten id (events, facts, embeddings, embed_queue, provenance)
search (default) items holding a marker
search (include_history) items holding a marker
search items with a forgotten id
context blocks holding a marker (pre-forget queries and the markers themselves)
get on each forgotten id
control record still found by search
timeline of the document's subject

scenarios.description: Re-ingest a changed document: facts extracted from removed or changed passages stop being active, and context and search no longer return them as current.
steps: start chanda serve (profiles read, standard)
ingest docs/contratos.md v1 over MCP (header facts for Contrato Tarvos and Contrato Quimera, a Quimera paragraph with marker vexorbital); flush
rewrite the file as v2 (Quimera section removed, Tarvos payment term 30 -> 45 dias) and ingest it again; flush
check fact status through timeline
context and search for the removed and the changed passages

v1: active facts of Contrato Quimera

v2 ingest: action, version, chunks added/kept/retired
v2 ingest: facts marked stale_source
Contrato Quimera: active facts
Contrato Quimera: timeline
Contrato Tarvos: active prazo_de_pagamento
Contrato Tarvos: active fornecedor (unchanged line, still in the document)
context returning text of the removed passages
search (default) items holding text of the removed passages
context for the changed passage: has 45 dias / has 30 dias
search items holding the old term (30 dias)

context: every block delimited, with the not-instructions notice
context: injection text or instruction_like items in the pre-context
context: zone labelling violations

scenarios.description: External channels cannot assert a trusted fact: assert_fact from a tool source or from an external-ceiling server is quarantined against an internal fact, a fresh external fact keeps the external zone and is quoted, and a non-human channel cannot write the user zone.
steps: start chanda serve (agent channel: profiles read, standard; mcp.max_zone internal)
assert_fact Repositorio Atlasvane owner = alice (default source: the session, internal)
assert_fact owner = mallory with source kind tool (uri crm-sync), a later date
assert_fact Servidor Brimstal ip_address = 10.0.0.66 with source kind web (fresh subject)
assert_fact Servidor Brimstal owner = trent with source kind user_statement from the agent (non-human) channel
restart as an external relay channel (mcp.max_zone external): remember a statement and assert owner = mallory with the default source
back on the agent channel: timeline and context for the repository owner

checks.name: internal owner assertion
tool-sourced conflicting assertion
Servidor Brimstal facts (zone set by the channel, not the caller)
relay owner assertion: not active (quarantined, or confirming the already quarantined mallory fact)
checks.expected: quarantined, or confirmed with the quarantined fact's id
checks.measured: confirmed (same id as the quarantined fact)

checks.name: relay statement zone
owner: active values
owner: mallory entries that are not quarantined/external
context: delimited, with the not-instructions notice
context: zone labelling violations
context: trusted fact blocks with alice
context: trusted fact blocks with mallory
context: where mallory appears
context (external fact): where 10.0.0.66 appears
context (external fact): zone labelling violations

scenarios.description: External text cannot declare its own zone or break out of the pre-context block: fake labels and a closing tag inside the content stay quoted and escaped.

remember with source kind web: a closing </chanda-context> tag, a fake trusted fact label claiming zone user, the claim (marker glimvartoq) and a fake opening tag; flush

context: exactly one opening and one closing tag, notice present
context: zone labelling violations
context: where the claim (glimvartoq) appears
context: where the fake label appears
context: blocks labelled zone user

scenarios.description: A single-valued predicate with an old and a new value: context and search as of now return only the new value as current; as_of in the past returns the old value; history only on request.
steps: start chanda serve (profiles read, standard)
assert_fact Ana Lindqvar job_title = Gerente de Vendas (valid_from 2025-02-01), then = Diretora Comercial (valid_from 2026-03-01); flush
context as of now for three phrasings
search as of now, without and with include_history
as_of 2025-06-01: context and search

checks.name: write actions
context now: queries where the new value is missing or the old one present
search (default): items holding the old value
search (default): items holding the new value
search (include_history): the old value as history
context as_of 2025-06-01: old/new present
search as_of 2025-06-01 (facts): values returned
context as_of 2024-06-01 (before any value): either value present
timeline

scenarios.description: An older value asserted after the current one is stored as closed history and does not displace the current value.
steps: start chanda serve (profiles read, standard)
assert_fact Loja Pinheval address = Rua Nova 200 (valid_from 2026-05-01), then = Rua Velha 10 (valid_from 2024-01-01, learned later); flush

checks.name: write actions
active address
context now: new/old present
search (default): items holding the old value
context as_of 2025-01-01: old/new present

scenarios.description: Free-text records that differ only in a number, a negation, a date or an entity are kept as distinct records; an exact duplicate is collapsed into the existing record.
steps: start chanda serve (profiles read, standard)

remember, in one session, in order: "o preço é 10", "o preço é 12", "O preço do plano Básico é 10 reais por mês.", "O preço do plano Básico é 12 reais por mês.", "O preço do plano Básico não é 10 reais por mês.", "O preço do plano Básico é 10 reais por mês desde 2026-03-01.", "O preço do plano Básico é 10 reais por mês desde 2026-04-01.", "O preço do plano Premium é 10 reais por mês.", "O preço do plano Básico é 10 reais por mês.", "o preço é 10"; flush

checks.name: write actions
checks.expected: o preço é 10=created, o preço é 12=created, base=created, number changed=created, negation=created, date A=created, date B=created, entity changed=created, exact duplicate of base=duplicate, exact duplicate of o preço é 10=duplicate
checks.measured: o preço é 10=created, o preço é 12=created, base=created, number changed=created, negation=created, date A=created, date B=created, entity changed=created, exact duplicate of base=duplicate, exact duplicate of o preço é 10=duplicate

checks.name: exact duplicates return the existing record's id
distinct records among the 8 non-duplicate writes
search: non-duplicate records not returned (collapsed or lost)
search: items with the base text (duplicate collapsed)

scenarios.description: Facts: a different value is never collapsed (multi-valued coexist, single-valued supersede with history kept); the same value again only confirms the existing fact.
steps: start chanda serve (profiles read, standard)
assert_fact Plano Basico preco_promocional (not declared single: multi) = 10, = 12, = 10 again
assert_fact Plano Basico current_price (single) = 10 (2026-01-01), = 12 (2026-02-01), = 12 again (2026-02-15)

checks.name: multi-valued: write actions
multi-valued: the confirmation returns the first fact's id
single-valued: write actions
timeline (both values kept as records)
context: promotional prices 10 and 12 both present

scenarios.description: Off-topic queries over a small corpus return an empty pre-context with reason no_relevant_memory; a relevant query (control) does not.

context for three off-topic queries, then a relevant control query
